description: Checkout, Paystack test-mode payment, notifications, and customer order tracking. Checkout gate (session AND verified email), shipping address saved to account, server-recomputed order summary; order creation with price snapshots; Paystack init + server-side verify + webhook with HMAC-SHA512 signature check and idempotent mark-paid + stock decrement; notify() service (Notification row + Resend email, failures logged) wired for order-paid (customer + admin); in-app notifications view; customer orders list and detail with a status stepper. Covers tasks.md tasks 7, 8, 9, 10. Depends on FEAT-002 (auth) and FEAT-003 (cart).
steps: Build src/app/(shop)/checkout/page.tsx (server component): via getCurrentUser(), redirect unauthenticated -> /login?callbackUrl=/checkout; if authenticated but emailVerified==null render a verify prompt with a resend-verification button (no redirect loop); otherwise render the CheckoutForm.

Create src/app/api/addresses/route.ts (POST): requireUser, addressSchema validate, create/update the user's Address (name, phone, street, city, state, country default 'Nigeria', postalCode), support isDefault.

Create src/lib/orders.ts with summarizeCart(items) (re-reads product prices/stock from DB, returns server-authoritative line items + totalKobo), createOrder(userId, cartItems, addressId) (re-validate stock/prices, create Order PENDING + OrderItems with nameSnapshot + unitPriceKobo), and markOrderPaid(reference, paidAmountKobo) (idempotent: guard paidAt==null; assert paidAmountKobo >= order.totalKobo; set status PAID + paidAt, append OrderStatusEvent(PAID), decrement product stock; then call notify customer + notifyAdminNewOrder). Define the allowed status-transition map here too (used by FEAT-005): PAID->APPROVED->PROCESSING->SHIPPED->DELIVERED and any-active->CANCELLED, plus advanceStatus(orderId, next) that validates and appends an event + customer notification.

Create src/components/checkout-form.tsx ('use client'): reads cart (useCart), posts address, shows the server-recomputed order summary (via a server action calling summarizeCart), and a 'Pay with Paystack' button that posts to /api/checkout.

Create src/lib/paystack.ts: initTransaction({email, amountKobo, reference, metadata}) (POST Paystack /transaction/initialize with Bearer PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY, returns authorization_url + reference) and verifyTransaction(reference) (GET /transaction/verify/:ref, returns status + amount).

Create src/app/api/checkout/route.ts (POST): gate session+emailVerified, createOrder, generate/attach paystackRef, initTransaction for the server-recomputed totalKobo + user email + metadata.orderId, save ref on the order, return authorization_url.
Create src/app/(shop)/checkout/callback/page.tsx: read ?reference, call the verify endpoint, show success/failure (retry link on failure/abandon leaves the order PENDING).
Create src/app/api/payments/verify/route.ts (GET): verifyTransaction(reference); on success and amount matches order.totalKobo, call markOrderPaid; return result.

Create src/app/api/payments/webhook/route.ts (POST): export const runtime='nodejs'; read raw body via req.text(); compute HMAC-SHA512 of the raw body with PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY and compare to the x-paystack-signature header using crypto.timingSafeEqual; on 'charge.success' call markOrderPaid (idempotent); always return 200 quickly after validation.

Create src/lib/notify.ts: notify(userId,{title,body,orderId?}) writes a Notification row then sends a Resend email via src/lib/email.ts wrapped so failures are logged and NOT thrown; notifyAdminNewOrder(order) emails ADMIN_EMAIL. Wire both into markOrderPaid.
Create src/app/api/notifications/route.ts (GET list current user's notifications, PATCH mark read) and build src/app/(shop)/account/notifications/page.tsx listing them with read state.

Create src/app/api/orders/route.ts (GET current user's orders) and build src/app/(shop)/orders/page.tsx (list: id, date, status, formatted total) and src/app/(shop)/orders/[id]/page.tsx (items, address, a StatusStepper from statusHistory ordered by createdAt, plus a post-payment processing message). Gate both with requireUser(). Create src/components/status-stepper.tsx. Mark DB-touching segments dynamic='force-dynamic'.
acceptance_criteria: Checkout redirects unauthenticated users to login and blocks unverified users with a resend prompt; verified users see an address form + server-recomputed summary.
Order is created PENDING with OrderItem price snapshots; totals are recomputed server-side from the DB, never trusting client prices.
Payment is marked PAID ONLY through the server-side verify endpoint or the webhook; both converge on one markOrderPaid guarded on paidAt==null; the paid amount is checked against order.totalKobo.
The webhook validates x-paystack-signature as HMAC-SHA512 of the raw body using a timing-safe comparison.
notify() writes a Notification row and sends a Resend email; an email failure is logged and does not block marking the order paid; the admin is emailed on a new paid order.
Customer can see an orders list and an order detail with a status stepper built from OrderStatusEvent history.
'npx tsc --noEmit', 'npx next lint', and 'npx next build' all pass.

DONE. Verification: prisma validate + generate OK, tsc --noEmit clean, next lint clean, next build succeeded (10/10). DB not run (no local Postgres, per context.json fallback). Route render modes confirmed in build output: /api/{checkout,payments/verify,payments/webhook,addresses,orders,notifications} are ƒ dynamic; /checkout, /orders, /orders/[id] are ƒ (force-dynamic); /checkout/callback + /account/notifications are client pages (static shell, fetch at runtime).

SECURITY INVARIANTS — all held:
- Payment marked PAID ONLY server-side. The verify endpoint (/api/payments/verify GET) and the webhook (/api/payments/webhook POST) BOTH converge on markOrderPaid in src/lib/orders.ts. There is no client path that can set status PAID.
- markOrderPaid is idempotent: guards on order.paidAt==null (early-returns alreadyPaid=true), AND uses a conditional updateMany(where paidAt:null) inside a $transaction so concurrent verify+webhook callers are race-safe (only the winner decrements stock / fires notifications). Amount check: returns error if paidAmountKobo < order.totalKobo (anti-tampering) BEFORE applying.
- Webhook: export const runtime='nodejs' + dynamic='force-dynamic'. Reads RAW body via req.text() BEFORE parsing. Computes HMAC-SHA512(rawBody, PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY) hex and compares to x-paystack-signature using crypto.timingSafeEqual over equal-length Buffers (length-guarded; returns 401 on missing/mismatch). Only acts on event=='charge.success'; always returns 200 after signature validation (even on JSON parse failure or markOrderPaid error — logged, not retried).
- Never trusts client prices: /api/checkout + the getOrderSummary server action only accept {productId, quantity}; summarizeCart/createOrder re-read Product.priceKobo + stock from the DB and recompute totalKobo. OrderItems snapshot nameSnapshot + unitPriceKobo. createOrder re-validates stock before creating.
- Checkout gate = session AND emailVerified!=null, enforced in BOTH the /checkout page (redirect to /login?callbackUrl=/checkout if no session; verify prompt if emailVerified==null — no redirect loop) AND /api/checkout (401 no session, 403 emailVerified==null). emailVerified is re-fetched via prisma.user.findUnique since it is NOT on the JWT/session (per FEAT-002 note).
- Email failures never block: notify()/notifyAdminNewOrder in src/lib/notify.ts wrap sendEmail in try/catch, log, and never throw; markOrderPaid calls them AFTER the DB transaction commits.
- Prices in KOBO throughout; Paystack amounts sent/verified in kobo.

INTEGRATION NOTES for FEAT-005 (admin):
- STATUS MAP: `import { ORDER_STATUS_TRANSITIONS, canTransition, advanceStatus } from "@/lib/orders"`. ORDER_STATUS_TRANSITIONS: Record<OrderStatus,OrderStatus[]> = PENDING->[PAID,CANCELLED], PAID->[APPROVED,CANCELLED], APPROVED->[PROCESSING,CANCELLED], PROCESSING->[SHIPPED,CANCELLED], SHIPPED->[DELIVERED,CANCELLED], DELIVERED->[], CANCELLED->[]. advanceStatus(orderId,next,note?) validates via canTransition, updates Order.status + appends OrderStatusEvent in a $transaction, then fires a customer notify(). The admin POST /api/orders/[id]/status route (FEAT-005) should role-gate then call advanceStatus. New-order indicator = count of orders status PAID.
- ORDERS/NOTIFY HELPERS: `import { summarizeCart, createOrder, markOrderPaid } from "@/lib/orders"`; `import { notify, notifyAdminNewOrder } from "@/lib/notify"`; `import { initTransaction, verifyTransaction } from "@/lib/paystack"`.
- paystackRef format: `DE-<orderId>-<uuid>`, saved on the order after init; webhook/verify look up Order by unique paystackRef.
- ADDRESSES: POST /api/addresses (requireUser via getCurrentUser 401) validates addressSchema, clears prior isDefault when isDefault=true, returns {address}. The checkout-form saves the address first (isDefault:true), then passes address.id to /api/checkout which re-verifies ownership.
- NOTIFICATIONS: GET /api/notifications (user's, newest first), PATCH marks read (all if no id, or {id}). /account/notifications is the client view. src/components/status-stepper.tsx renders the happy-path PENDING..DELIVERED from statusHistory (CANCELLED shown as a terminal callout). notifyAdminNewOrder uses env.optional('ADMIN_EMAIL') and skips+logs if unset (so build/runtime without ADMIN_EMAIL doesn't crash).
- ENV used: PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY (init+verify+webhook HMAC), PAYSTACK_PUBLIC_KEY (returned to client, optional), RESEND via email.ts, ADMIN_EMAIL (optional for admin notify).
